note: Bookshop creator-referral detection + own-affiliate injection. Migrated from isBookshopPathReferral() (cleaner.js:274-277), MUGA_BOOKSHOP_AFFILIATE_ID (cleaner.js:283), and injection block (cleaner.js:465-476) (issue #625). 5-condition injection guard split: [JSON] (1) domain match via 'domain' field; (2) path/param data via 'injectPath' + 'injectParam' (inject only when param absent). [CODE] (3) prefs.injectOwnAffiliate; (4) !prefs.stripAllAffiliates; (5) action !== 'detected_foreign'. Runtime: !creatorReferralPreserved. See getPathAffiliatePolicy() in src/lib/path-rules.js (data half) and processUrl() in src/lib/cleaner.js (runtime half). #959: when stripAllAffiliates is ON, the /a/CREATOR/DEST wrapper is UNWRAPPED to DEST (foreign creator attribution removed) using 'unwrapReferral' (capture group 1 is the destination path, or an embedded same-origin absolute URL). If injectOwnAffiliate is also ON and DEST is a /p/ product page, MUGA's own affiliate param is injected on top per the normal injectPath rule. /shop/NAME never unwraps (unwrapReferral only matches /a/.../..., never /shop/...), so a bookstore's own storefront is never touched. Known limitation: injectPath stays scoped to /p/, so /a/CREATOR/lists/... unwraps to /lists/... (foreign wrapper removed) but never receives injection, since broadening injectPath to /lists/ would change the injection contract for ALL Bookshop flows, not just this unwrap case. When stripAllAffiliates is OFF, behavior is unchanged: /a/ paths are preserved exactly (honor-creator).
